findings_summary: Baseline established: avg quality_score=0.908, belief_index=0.900, manifest_truthfulness=0.947 (n=9 manifests, 2026-04-28).
Bundle cost driver identified: HONEY.md 62KB (15,596 tokens) + NECTAR.md 97KB (24,454 tokens). Tail-30 bundles ~17K tokens; full-injection bundles ~41K tokens.
7 safety gates defined with auto-revert triggers: G004 (context pressure rise), G006 (capability probe failure), G001 (FFMx discovery drop >10%). Investigation holds: G002, G003, G005, G007.

3-phase protocol: Phase 1 (baseline measurement, 5-10 spawns, instrument bundle_size_bytes), Phase 2 (C1+C2+C3 compression isolation then combined), Phase 3 (FFMx delta + 5 capability probes + gate validation).
Wave-aware compression strategy: W1 full (C1+C2+C3, 55-70% target), W2 medium (C1+C2, 45-60%), W3 light (C2 only, 20-35%) — preserves W3 synthesis depth.
Key trade-off: C1 (NECTAR filter) highest risk. Mitigation: per-agent-type filter threshold config + bundle_mode=full escape valve.
FFMx should IMPROVE post-compression: cost_efficiency (0.54) should decrease as bundle tokens drop, pushing FFMx from 44.4 toward ~48+ if compression achieves 65% bundle reduction.
Primary instrumentation gap: bundle_size_bytes and manifest_write_latency_ms not yet recorded in manifests. These are Phase 1 preconditions before any compression can be validated.
